entities.summary: The Bourse des Valeurs Mobilières de Tunis (BVMT) or Bourse de Tunis is a stock exchange based in Tunis, Tunisia. It was founded in 1969, and currently lists around 50 stocks. Bourse De Tunis is a stock exchange in Tunis, established in 1969-02-01. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
